PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return (C-section, home mat)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Gradual postpartum return to fitness"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Early Recovery" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Gentle walk + mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x30..60 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          heel_taps 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Low-impact mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x6..8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Walk + core-safe activation":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x6..8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x15..20 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 22m "Progress walk + mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x45..60 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Full-body gentle":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Mobility + breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Rebuild Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk + activation":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Lower body bodyweight":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Mobility & posterior chain":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          good_morning 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          back_extension 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk + core-safe stability":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Lower progression":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lunge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Full-body gentle":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x5..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Strength Introduction (post 6-week clearance)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Lower strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Upper strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Core-safe stability & mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..40 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Lower strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Full-body":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m

  PHASE "Phase 4 - Build Capacity" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Lower + conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Mobility & core-safe":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progressive lower":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lunge 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Progressive upper":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Full-body & stamina":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
